records.public_safe_text: this is traffic fatality #111 for the city of dallas in 2020. see related [case id]. unit 1 was traveling eastbound [roadway] at a high rate [roadway] [roadway]. unit 1 drove through [roadway] and traveled to the northeast across the westbound lanes of traffic, where it collided its left side wheels to the raised curb of a storm drain along the north curb, causing damage to the left side wheels. unit 1 traveled eastbound partially on the north sidewalk, then it came off of the sidewalk and started to rotate clockwise, as it traveled to the southeast, across the westbound and eastbound lanes of traffic. unit 1 left side wheels struck the south curb of [roadway], then unit 1 traveled backwards, while halfway on the south sidewalk with its right side raised off of the pavement, putting unit 1 at an angle. unit 2 pedestrian was sitting in his wheelchair, asleep on the south sidewalk of [roadway], between a dart bus stop sign and a dart bus stop bench, [roadway] at the time of the crash. for unknown reasons, unit 1 driver door opened and unit 1 driver, who was not wearing his seatbelt, came out of unit 1 and he and the inside area of the driver door struck the dart bus stop sign. unit 1 collided back left to unit 2 pedestrian, then unit 1 collided back left to the concrete dart bus stop bench, pusing it to the southeast and completely ejecting unit 1 driver out of the vehicle. unit 1 driver struck his head on the concrete dart bus stop bench, causing a fatal head injury. unit 1 continued traveling backwards at [roadway] and collided back concentrated (back right area) to two wooden light poles, along the south sidewalk, shearing both of the light poles at the base. unit 1 [roadway] of [roadway], where it rolled over, while traveling in an eastbound direction, then unit 1 struck a chain-link fence in the southeast corner of the intersection with the top right side and hood and came to rest upright on the sidewalk, facing northeast. the dispatched dallas fire rescue fire fighters arrived on scene and found unit 1 driver to have no signs of life at 2:34 am on [date]. [medical facility] by a dallas fire rescue ambulance. a representative from the dallas county medical examiner's office responded to the scene and took possession of unit 1 driver remains, [case id]. the on-duty traffic crash investigator sergeant responded to the scene and created a forensic 3-d scan of the crash scene. a dwi police responded to the scene to assist i/o. a vehicle crimes unit detective responded to the location, took photographs and interviewed a possible next of kin for unit 1 driver. i/o measured a section of yaw mark, prior to unit 1 striking the storm drain, along the north curb to determine a speed for unit 1. i/o used the critical curve speed formula and a drag factor range of 0. 7 and 0. 8. i/o determined that unit 1 was traveling between 76 mph and 82 mph, which is over the posted speed limit of 30 mph. (speeding over the limit) due to the size of the entire crash scene, i/o was not able to include the entire crash scene with the first aoi in the diagram. this report is incomplete pending toxicology results for unit 1 driver. ********** on [date], i/o #8502 supplemented this report to include the blood results for unit 1 driver. unit 1 driver blood results showed to be positive for drug. drug - phencyclidine: 0. 14 +/- 0. 02 mg/l. i/o added a contributing factor of 68 - under the influence of drug to this report for unit 1 driver. this report is now complete. **********
